name: VPN
author: Juan Casanas
description: One-click NetworkManager VPN toggle (OpenVPN, WireGuard) for the Omarchy bar

barWidget.description: Shows NetworkManager VPN state; click to connect or disconnect

schema.label: Preferred VPN profile
schema.description: NetworkManager connection name to connect when several VPN profiles exist. Empty uses the first one.

schema.label: Right-click command
schema.description: Command run on right-click, normally the NetworkManager connection editor.

schema.label: Desktop notifications
schema.description: Send a notification after each connect or disconnect.
